node ### Purpose - Use this lane for Node.js 20 application REQs that implement HTTP handlers, auth middleware, validation, idempotency, logging, and domain commands or queries. - In this project, REQ-002 through REQ-007 use this lane. ### REQ Usage Rules - Use for REST endpoint logic and shared application modules under `src`. - A REQ using this lane is expected to emit handler code, domain logic, tests, and API verification assets. - Combine with `sql` when a REQ changes persistence contracts or migrations. - Combine with `aws` only when deployment wiring or CloudWatch integration is part of scope. - Do not create parallel top-level application roots outside `src` and `tests`. ### Tools - tests: `npm run test:unit`, `npm run test:integration`, `npm run test:e2e` - lint: `npm run lint` - types: `npm run typecheck` - security: `npm audit --omit=dev` - build: `npm run build` ### Artifacts Expected - Test reports in `artifacts/test/` or `coverage/` - Coverage report in `coverage/lcov.info` and summary text in `artifacts/test/coverage-summary.txt` - API request assets under `runs/kit//test/api/` - Structured log sample or log field assertion output under `artifacts/observability/` - `/eval` should be able to normalize unit, integration, e2e, coverage, and API asset outputs ### CLI Examples - Local: `npm ci && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration` - Containerized: `docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/work -w /work node:20 bash -lc "npm ci && npm run lint && npm run test:integration"` ### Default Gate Policy - min coverage: 80 percent lines on touched files - max criticals: 0 - fail conditions: lint failure, typecheck failure, missing auth deny test where auth applies, missing audit assertion where state changes, missing no-side-effect assertion for read or deny paths, missing API asset for HTTP REQs ### Lane-Specific Failure Modes - Auth middleware exists but routes bypass it - Validation rejects too late after persistence attempt - Idempotency key accepted but duplicate writes still occur - Read handlers accidentally update timestamps or audit rows - Logs exist but omit request_id or route fields - Tests only cover happy path and miss conflict or deny behavior ### Enterprise Runner Notes - SonarQube: optional external quality scan, not a substitute for repo test evidence - GitHub Actions is the canonical runner for this project; fetch artifacts from workflow run summaries and uploaded artifacts - Jenkins: not the target runner; do not design node evidence paths around Jenkins-specific plugins ### TECH_CONSTRAINTS Integration - air-gap: not specified, do not assume offline package mirrors - registries: default npm registry unless the environment supplies an internal mirror - tokens and secrets handling: use environment variables or secret stores only, never committed files - runtime: target Node.js 20 behavior only END_FILE BEGIN_FILE docs/harper/lane-guides/sql.md ## Lane Guide tests. ### Tools - tests: `npm run db:migrate:test` - lint: SQL style validation through repo script or migration review checklist - types: schema contract validation through application type generation if present - security: dependency and migration review for unsafe dynamic SQL - build: migration packaging or schema export through repo script ### Artifacts Expected - Migration files under `src/platform/db/migrations/` - Migration logs under `artifacts/db/migrations/` - Schema verification report under `artifacts/db/schema-check.txt` - Optional schema dump under `artifacts/db/schema.sql` - `/eval` should normalize migration success, constraint assertions, and replayability evidence ### CLI Examples - Local: `npm run db:migrate:test` - Containerized: `docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/work -w /work postgres:16 bash -lc "psql --version"` followed by repo migration test command in the app container ### Default Gate Policy - min coverage: not line-based, require at least one migration integration test per changed migration set - max criticals: 0 - fail conditions: migration cannot run from empty database, migration is not replayable in CI, missing constraint tests for lifecycle fields, foreign key failures, destructive change without explicit migration path ### Lane-Specific Failure Modes - Application code assumes columns not created by migrations - Lifecycle states exist in code but not in schema constraints - Audit columns are missing request_id or actor trace fields - Idempotency storage is omitted so write REQs invent inconsistent behavior - Migrations are valid once but fail on a fresh environment ### Enterprise Runner Notes - SonarQube: may not inspect SQL deeply; rely on migration test artifacts - GitHub Actions is the canonical
